description: The plot illustrates the loss comparison of two experiments, Ex1 and Ex2, during the Embedding and LM Head training stage. The x-axis represents the training steps, ranging from 0 to 60,000, while the y-axis shows the loss values, ranging from 2 × 10⁰ to 1.2 × 10¹. The Ex1 Loss starts at approximately 4 × 10⁰ and steadily declines to less than 2 × 10⁰ by 60,000 steps. The Ex2 Loss begins at around 3 × 10⁰ and stabilizes at 2.5 × 10⁰ after 20,000 steps. The Ex1 Validation Loss starts above 1.1 × 10¹ and decreases sharply to 3 × 10⁰ by 10,000 steps, then stabilizes. The Ex2 Validation Loss begins slightly below 1.1 × 10¹ and declines to 4 × 10⁰ by 20,000 steps, remaining higher than Ex1 Validation Loss throughout the training process.
